subject: Re: Incident coverage transfer & renewal — SignalHelm contract consolidation
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@signalhelm.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal — Consolidation & coverage transfer for CloudArc (SignalHelm)

Hi Jonas / Aditya,

Thanks for the time last week — per our conversation I put together a single-page SOW and a proposed consolidation plan for CloudArc. They currently have two active SignalHelm orgs (cloudarc-prod / cloudarc-tools) and want a single consolidated pool for on-call and incident notification routing. Key points in the attached SOW: 

- Consolidate two orgs into one managed account
- Maintain historical incidents for 90 days; full export available on request
- Transfer existing escalation policies with a cutover window (see coverage-mapping.xlsx)
- Recommended annual plan: 250 active seats + 3 enterprise routing keys

We can offer a one-time consolidation credit to offset prorated overlap and a 10% volume discount if they commit to 12 months. I attached the draft SOW and a simple coverage mapping to show handoff dates and which teams change their primary responders.

Next steps from our side: updated invoice (final seat count) and a DocuSign link for signatures. From your side: confirmation of the PO route and any procurement constraints (PO vs. CC, required billing contact, legal redline cadence).

Attaching: SignalHelm_SOW_Q3-2026.pdf, coverage-mapping.xlsx

Best,
Maya Singh
Enterprise Partnerships | SignalHelm
maya@signalhelm.io
+1 (415) 555-0112
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@signalhelm.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — Consolidation & coverage transfer for CloudArc (SignalHelm)

Maya — thanks for the doc and the mapping. A few items for clarity before we present this to CloudArc finance/procurement: 

1) Final pricing: need an invoice example showing the 12-month price, and the prorated credit calculation for the mid-quarter consolidation. Can you show both line items (list price, consolidated discount, credit)?

2) Migration window: our Ops team needs a 48-hour planned cutover window (no scheduled deployments) and a rollback plan. Can SignalHelm commit to a 72-hour support window around the cutover (technical onboarding + troubleshooting)?

3) Security/compliance: CloudArc requires SSO via SAML + SCIM provisioning and a backup of audit logs delivered to their S3 bucket for 180 days. Is the audit export covered in the SOW or do we need a separate service item?

4) Legal: will you accept our standard PO + signature (no additional MSA) or do you require a counter-signed SOW + MSA? If you need a redline, route to contracts@signalhelm.io and cc procurement@redwood.com.

If you can get me a consolidated invoice and a DocuSign link with the credit applied, I'll forward to CloudArc procurement and loop Evelyn for operational approval.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-27T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — Consolidation & coverage transfer for CloudArc (SignalHelm)

Looping in procurement notes for the record (Jonas asked me to add formal steps):

- We need an updated pro-forma invoice showing: seat count, list price, discount, one-time consolidation credit, tax line, payment terms (Net30/Net45).
- Redwood standard PO is fine if SignalHelm is willing to accept a PO + signature on the SOW. If SignalHelm requires an MSA, please provide a clean MSA for our legal to review; expect 3–5 business days for redlines.
- Send invoices to billing@redwood.com and cc procurement@redwood.com.
- For vendor onboarding: submit a security attestation or link to their SOC2 report. We will not sign until the SOC2 summary or an active compliance page is provided.

Jonas — please confirm whether CloudArc requires vendor attachments (W9, MPO) on the PO. If so, we'll request them from SignalHelm.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Maya Singh <maya@signalhelm.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@signalhelm.io
Date: 2026-06-28T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Updated SOW + DocuSign (SignalHelm_SOW_Q3-2026)

Thanks — attaching an updated SOW that includes: the 10% consolidation discount, a prorated credit calculation example, and our proposed 72-hour cutover support window. Also added a note that audit exports (180 days) are included as part of our enterprise plan (no separate charge).

We uploaded the MSA to contracts and opened a DocuSign envelope for the SOW (link below). We can accept Redwood's PO as long as billing goes to billing@signalhelm.io and the PO references the SOW ID: SH-SOW-1892.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/ee/ABC123-SignalHelm-SOW
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/s/SL-2026-4387

Attachment notes:
- SignalHelm_SOW_Q3-2026.pdf (attached) — includes cutover plan + rollback checklist
- coverage-mapping.xlsx (attached) — shows per-team escalation policy mapping and proposed cutover dates

If procurement needs the SOC2 link: https://signalhelm.io/compliance/soc2-summary

Let me know if you want me to build a separate invoice with CloudArc billing details.

Best,
Maya
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Updated SOW + DocuSign (SignalHelm_SOW_Q3-2026)

Jonas — reviewed the SOW and the cutover checklist. I'm comfortable approving the consolidation and discount provided the following are agreed in writing before sign: 

- Confirmed 72-hour support window with named SignalHelm engineer on-call for the cutover date (include escalation contact + phone).
- Rollback window clearly documented and tested in staging at least 3 business days prior to production cutover.
- Audit exports delivered to CloudArc S3 URI within 24 hours of cutover completion.

Aditya — please proceed with the PO once SignalHelm updates the DocuSign envelope to reference the PO number and billing to CloudArc finance. Jonas — please coordinate the exact cutover dates (looking at 2026-07-17 to avoid product freeze).

Approve to proceed conditionally.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Site Reliability & Ops
Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
